candidates.description: 介绍进入情景式面试环节

candidates.transcript_evidence: It is designed to assess your skills, problem-solving abilities, and how you handle various situations.
So each scenario will offer a unique challenge, encouraging critical thinking.
candidates.description: 提及每个情景提供独特挑战

candidates.transcript_evidence: Just interested in understanding your approach and thought.
candidates.description: 表达对方法和思维过程的兴趣
切换到第一个情景：冲突优先级

candidates.transcript_evidence: Now you have two major assignments due on the same day.
candidates.description: 说明两个主要作业同一天截止

candidates.transcript_evidence: So one for your major course. Yeah, major course. And another for an elective one.
candidates.description: 描述作业分别来自主修课和选修课

candidates.transcript_evidence: So both assignments are equally important.
candidates.description: 说明两个作业同等重要
询问如何处理这种情况

candidates.transcript_evidence: I mean, how to do your time management by the deadline summit?
candidates.description: 询问截止日期前的时间管理方法

candidates.transcript_evidence: I hope I'm having us going on link back in a future video.
candidates.description: 表示希望未来视频中保持联系

candidates.transcript_evidence: But a break, if possible in the future.
I would love looking forward to seeing what you guys are doing in the future.
candidates.description: 表达对未来活动的期待

limitations: 转录包含非英文片段（如韩语）及不完整或非语义内容（如告别语段），仅提取有意义片段
结尾部分以告别和道别为主，未提取为独立语义候选
转录末尾关于策略的讨论不完整，仅提取明确陈述的内容
